title: Iron Cathedral
author: Freek van Gool
description: A dark, technical neurofunk track in E phrygian at 174 BPM, 128 bars (about 2 minutes 57): a constantly morphing formant bass with a clean sub, a second detune-stack layer in the second drop, dry tight drums with a gated snare, metal stabs, risers, impacts, stutter fills, and a bare drone and dissonant cluster for the intro and the break. Intro, build, drop 1, break, build 2, drop 2 and outro. Checked on paper and with measurements only; not listened to.
